stemMd: A service converts 100 units of currency P to Q at 2 Q per P, charging 5% of the Q received. It then converts all remaining Q back at 0.5 P per Q with no further fee. How many P return?
explanationMd: The first conversion gives 200 Q before fees and 190 Q after the 5% deduction. Converting back at 0.5 gives 95 P. The reciprocal rates cancel apart from the fee.

distractorRationale.a: Deducts a five-unit fee twice from the original 100, rather than charging the stated one-time fee.
distractorRationale.d: A fee reduces rather than increases the returned amount.
